page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom; no margin notes. Pencilled number 28 at top right and a pencilled shelf mark and stamp at the foot are not printed text.

main_text.l: Bernatum Lycæo Professoris ordinarij, p.t. Rectoris Magnifici, fautoris & Præceptoris sui,
Ad diem 5. Novemb. horis locoq; solitis.

page.notes: The ornament between the place-of-printing lines and the date is a woodcut device, not text. The line "Ad diem 5. Novemb." has a large swash N in "Novemb."; the abbreviation "locoq;" is transcribed as printed. The date reads MDCLXXIV as printed, with the stroke of the final numeral as shown in the scan (MDC LXXIV).
